# Domain Model: Administration
Entities: 2, Associations: 1, Enumerations: 0

## Entities
- ENTITY Administration.Account (persistent, generalization=System.User)
  - ATTR Email: StringAttributeType
  - ATTR FullName: StringAttributeType
  - ATTR IsLocalUser: BooleanAttributeType
  - ACCESS_RULE rule-1 [Administration.Administrator] Create=yes, Delete=yes, Default=Unknown
    - MEMBER Administration.Account.FullName: ReadWrite
    - MEMBER Administration.Account.Email: ReadWrite
    - MEMBER Administration.Account.IsLocalUser: ReadOnly
    - MEMBER Administration.AccountPasswordData_Account: None
  - ACCESS_RULE rule-2 [Administration.User] Create=no, Delete=no, Default=Unknown
    - MEMBER Administration.Account.FullName: ReadOnly
    - MEMBER Administration.Account.Email: ReadOnly
    - MEMBER Administration.Account.IsLocalUser: None
    - MEMBER Administration.AccountPasswordData_Account: None
    - MEMBER Inspection.Inspector_Account: ReadOnly
  - ACCESS_RULE rule-3 [Administration.User] Create=no, Delete=no, Default=Unknown
    XPath: [id='[%CurrentUser%]']
    - MEMBER Administration.Account.FullName: ReadWrite
    - MEMBER Administration.Account.Email: None
    - MEMBER Administration.Account.IsLocalUser: None
    - MEMBER Administration.AccountPasswordData_Account: None
- ENTITY Administration.AccountPasswordData (non-persistent)
  - ATTR ConfirmPassword: StringAttributeType
  - ATTR NewPassword: StringAttributeType
  - ATTR OldPassword: StringAttributeType
  - ACCESS_RULE rule-1 [Administration.Administrator, Administration.User] Create=no, Delete=no, Default=Unknown
    - MEMBER Administration.AccountPasswordData.OldPassword: ReadWrite
    - MEMBER Administration.AccountPasswordData.NewPassword: ReadWrite
    - MEMBER Administration.AccountPasswordData.ConfirmPassword: ReadWrite
    - MEMBER Administration.AccountPasswordData_Account: ReadOnly

## Associations
